coupled_point_repair.f32_candidate_backtracking_policy: raw float64 single-node, 2-4 seed-corner and 8-16 authorized seed-vertex-star SLSQP candidates are checked at alpha 1,1/2,...,1/64 on complete incident stars; after alpha rejection, at most four one-ULP coordinate choices on actual regressed-good-cell witness points are tested; existing F32 native, exact sign, separation, cap, and role count/score gates remain unchanged

joint_small_patch_fallback.deadline: reserved slice remains inside the same per-patch deadline; full star and exact Float32 local gates before ledger acceptance
joint_small_patch_fallback.eligibility: after LP and node attempts when the current bad-face patch has no native bad-count reduction; prior score-only gains are retained; one 2-4 seed-corner solve is followed by at most one solve with 8-16 authorized movable rows from the seed tetrahedron one-ring, including neighboring currently-good cell corners as constrained variables

coupled_point_repair.ordinary_block_patch_policy: bad-face-connected patches run sequentially; overlapping free nodes and full stars are allowed only with current/baseline-good revalidation and cumulative per-node trust cap
coupled_point_repair.ordinary_outer_O_policy: bad O corners plus one direct incident O source-triangle ring; O back scope, outer scope, rims and routes remain fixed; cap <= 500um
coupled_point_repair.quality_step_policy: up to 10 continuous SLP steps at total trust cap / 10 each
coupled_point_repair.unified_inner_back_ordinary_policy: all baseline-bad face components use ordinary bad-corner/source-ring freedoms; I/D additionally use declared inner-back construction freedoms and authenticated actual-back Fat rows in each bad-cell star; ordinary O freedom is limited to bad-corner/source-ring rows at the ordinary cap (at most 500um); O back scope, outer scope, source rims and all 149 routes remain fixed

endpoint_quotient_anchor_policy.inherited_I_D_transition_policy: REPORT_ONLY; cap applies to each new immediate transition, not retroactively to accepted ancestors

npz_cow_append_policy: Complete desired NPZ payloads are diffed by the pinned 926b adapter using pinned 925 dtype/shape/order-A byte equality; only changed/new arrays and deletions are emitted through APFS clone-only updates; no full-copy fallback

source_I.comparison: independent dtype, shape, Fortran-contiguity and order-A byte comparison via pinned 925 helper

volume_Fat.comparison: independent dtype, shape, Fortran-contiguity and order-A byte comparison via pinned 925 helper

volume_Skin.comparison: independent dtype, shape, Fortran-contiguity and order-A byte comparison via pinned 925 helper

postquotient_source_cavity_remesh.accepted_ring_policy: prefer full same-material face ring; on existing cap overflow use intact complete endpoint-star union only if it fits

inner_mask.policy: I/D inner surface corner/ring and authenticated actual-back Fat points in the complete one-star of every baseline-bad cell

ordinary_mask.expansion_rule: exactly one set of source triangles incident to initially mutable bad-cell corners; no recursive flooding

unified_inner_back_ordinary.patch_priority_policy: Fat-seeded patches first; descending Fat seed bad-cell count, then summed Fat per-cell native log deficit; ties use Skin seed count then stable component id. Mixed Skin/Fat patches remain joint and retain complete cross-material stars.
unified_inner_back_ordinary.policy: all baseline-bad face components use the union of ordinary bad-corner/source-one-ring rows and I/D-inner plus actual-back Fat rows from every bad-corner star

roster.bad_component_connectivity: shared triangular faces among baseline native-bad tetrahedra
roster.scheduler_policy: Fat-seeded patches first; descending Fat seed bad-cell count, then summed Fat per-cell native log deficit; ties use Skin seed count then stable component id. Mixed Skin/Fat patches remain joint and retain complete cross-material stars.

expanded_component_closure.method: moved O/I/D surface-face plus Skin/Fat moved-node tetrahedron graph joined by exact Float32 coordinate identity
